title: Rhetoric in Classical Historiography: Four Studies
author: Woodman, A. J.
subject: classics; classical studies; ancient history; historiography; rhetoric; Roman history; Greek history; Thucydides; Sallust; Livy; Tacitus; Latin literature; Croom Helm
description: First edition, 1988, of Woodman's four studies on rhetoric and the writing of history in Greece and Rome, published by Croom Helm in London and Sydney and issued in the USA by Areopagitica Press, Portland. Hardcover in black cloth with gilt lettering to the spine, in the original unclipped cream dust jacket. A near fine copy: the jacket shows minor creasing at the head, and the upper corners of the boards are slightly bumped; the gilt is bright, the binding tight and square, and the text block clean with only light toning to the edges. Comprises studies on Thucydides, Sallust, Livy and Tacitus.
